skills.name: spotify-now-playing
skills.description: Read what the user is currently listening to on Spotify locally with zero API keys, fetch live time-synced lyrics via LRCLIB, or capture a local audio clip to hear the music multimodally via read_file. Use when the user asks what is playing

readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Spotify (`antigravity-spotify`) **Give your Google Antigravity agent real-time awareness of what is spinning on Spotify — complete with live synced lyrics and multimodal audio-ear listening, with zero API keys.** [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v0.2-2563EB?style=flat-square)](plugin.json) [![Zero-Auth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spotify-Zero--Auth-10B981?style=flat-square)](#highlights) [![Lyrics LRCLIB](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lyrics-LRCLIB%20Synced-0EA5E9?style=flat-square)](#cli--skill-quick-reference) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0F172A?style=flat-square)](#installation) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-334155?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [Highlights](#highlights) · [How It Works](#how-it-works) · [Installation](#installation) · [CLI & Skill Reference](#cli--skill-quick-reference) · [Verification](#verified-evidence) · [Privacy](#privacy--permissions)
--- > **Keep your agent quietly in tune with the music in the room without OAuth apps, API tokens, or KV-cache churn.** > > **Antigravity Spotify** pairs a zero-dependency local playback bridge (`macOS JXA`, `Linux MPRIS`, `Windows SMTC`) with **KV-cache-friendly lifecycle hooks**, key-free time-synced lyrics via **LRCLIB**, and a cross-platform **multimodal audio ear** (`CoreAudio Process Tap`, `BlackHole`, `PulseAudio/PipeWire`, `WASAPI`) so your agent can inspect captured clips via `read_file` and actually *hear* the song alongside an acoustic dynamics anchor. --- ## Highlights - **Zero-Auth Local Playback Awareness:** Reads artist, track, album, and exact playback position directly from your local Spotify desktop client — no Spotify Developer app, no OAuth tokens, and no external telemetry. - **KV-Cache Friendly Silence (`hooks.json`):** Emits `{}` whenever Spotify is closed or paused and skips mid-tool-loop turns (`invocationNum > 1`). Whispers `🎵 [Spotify Now Playing] Artist – Track (Album) [M:SS / M:SS] | 🎤 "active lyric"` **once per track change** per conversation. - **Live Time-Synced Lyrics (`lyrics.py`):** Queries open [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net) with local disk caching (`30d` hit / `24h` miss), smart title cleaning (`- feat. ...`, `(Remastered)`), and exact active-line slicing at `playerPosition`. - **Multimodal Audio Ear (`audio_ear.py` + `macos_sysaudio.swift`):** Captures a compact local `.mp3` snippet + pure-stdlib acoustic anchor (`RMS dB`, `Peak dB`, `Crest dB`, `-58 dB` silence ratio, 16-bin energy sparkline) so your agent can listen multimodally via `read_file` instead of guessing from text metadata. - **Ambient Etiquette Rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`):** Instructs agents never to derail focused debugging or engineering work over background music, and never to claim they heard audio waveforms from metadata alone. --- ## How It Works ```mermaid flowchart LR Spotify["Local Spotify Client"] --> Bridge["spotify_now.py"] Bridge --> Hook["KV-Cache-Friendly Hook (1x / track)"] Bridge --> Lyrics["LRCLIB Synced Lyrics + Disk Cache"] Bridge --> Ear["Audio Ear (CoreAudio Tap / BlackHole / Pulse / WASAPI)"] Ear --> Clip["128kbps MP3 + WAV Acoustic Anchor"] Clip --> Agent["Antigravity read_file (Multimodal Listen)"] ``` --- ## Installation Clone directly into Antigravity's global plugins directory (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-spotify`) and run the platform installer: You need Git, Python 3, Google Antigravity, and the Spotify desktop app. On Linux, install `playerctl` for MPRIS playback detection. Antigravity must be able to run `python3` from its environment for the playback hooks. On Windows, enable the `python3` command if your Python installation exposes only `python` or `py`. ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Aphygo/antigravity-spotify.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-spotify" & "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-spotify\scripts\install.ps1" ``` ### macOS & Linux (Bash / Zsh) ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aphygo/antigravity-spotify.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-spotify bash ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-spotify/scripts/install.sh ``` > **macOS Permissions Note:** On first run, macOS may prompt once for **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation** (reading Spotify track metadata) and **Screen & System Audio Recording** (native `macos_sysaudio` CoreAudio Process Tap capture when no BlackHole Multi-Output is active). --- ## CLI & Skill Quick Reference | Command | Purpose | Output | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `python3 scripts/spotify_now.py now [--json]` | Read active Spotify playback state, track & progress | One-line summary or structured JSON | | `python3 scripts/spotify_now.py lyrics [--full] [--json]` | Fetch LRCLIB lyrics & slice active line at `playerPosition` | Synced window (`▶` active) or full text | | `python3 scripts/spotify_now.py listen [--seconds 12] [--source auto\|sysaudio\|blackhole\|mic] [--json]` | Capture local audio clip + acoustic anchor metrics | `.mp3` path (`read_file` ready) + DSP anchor | | `python3 scripts/spotify_now.py doctor` | Check OS backend, query latency, `ffmpeg`, audio devices & cache | Diagnostic checklist | | `python3 scripts/spotify_now.py hook --event pre_invocation` | Lifecycle hook handler (`SessionStart` / `PreInvocation`) | `{"injectSteps": ...}` on track change, else `{}` | --- ## Verified Evidence | Component | Verified Behavior | Environment | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Unit Test Suite** | **11 / 11 tests passed** (`0.234s`): duration normalization, hook deduplication, mid-loop silence, LRCLIB cache & offline mode, WAV 440Hz sine vs silent detection | `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` | | **macOS Local Query** | `pgrep -x Spotify` guard (never launches closed Spotify) + JXA readout (`~25 ms` closed, live track & position verified on *Cisza*, *DJ Cam*, *Beck*) | macOS `26.6.2` (`arm64`) | | **LRCLIB Synced Lyrics** | Verified live `/api/get` + `clean_track_title` fallback + active-line slicing on *Keith Wallen – Teeth Marks* and *DJ Cam – Swim* | Live LRCLIB API + disk cache | | **Native CoreAudio Tap** | `macos_sysaudio.swift` compiled cleanly (`swiftc -O`) and captured live `11.96s` stereo MP3 (`RMS -15.3 dB`, `Crest 12.5 dB`) from Spotify playback | macOS `26.6.2` (`arm64`) + `ffmpeg` | --- ## Repository Structure ```text antigravity-spotify/ ├── .gitattributes ├── .gitignore ├── LICENSE ├── README.md ├── hooks.json ├── plugin.json ├── assets/ │ ├── hero.svg │ └── logo.svg ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md ├── scripts/ │ ├── audio_ear.py │ ├── install.ps1 │ ├── install.sh │ ├── lyrics.py │ ├── macos_sysaudio.swift │ └── spotify_now.py ├── skills/ │ └── spotify-now-playing/ │ └── SKILL.md └── tests/ ├── test_lyrics_and_ear.py └── test_spotify_now.py ``` --- ## Privacy & Permissions - **Local Playback & Audio Capture:** Track detection and audio capture run on your machine. The plugin keeps the latest 10 clips under `~/.cache/antigravity-spotify/clips/` by default. When you ask Antigravity to read a clip, your agent and model settings govern how it is processed. - **Lyrics Lookups:** Online lookups send the artist and track title to LRCLIB, along with the album and duration when available. - **Conversation History.** When a track changes, the track information and current lyric line can become part of the Antigravity conversation history. - **Strict Offline Mode:** Set `ANTIGRAVITY_SPOTIFY_OFFLINE=1` to disable all outbound LRCLIB lyrics requests (disk cache only). - **Never Auto-Launches Spotify:** On macOS, `pgrep -x Spotify` runs before JXA so querying status never starts Spotify when it is closed. --- ## Credits & License Licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) (`Copyright 2026 Aphygo`). Crafted by Philip Cederman & Saga (**Aphygo**), with the 3-layer multimodal audio-perception design inspired by cousin Gry's `Grys Öra` (*"FFT:en är kryckan, inte örat"*).
latestReleaseNotes:
## Spotify playback in Antigravity

Ask your agent what is playing in the Spotify desktop app. Antigravity Spotify adds the track, artist, and playback position on the next agent turn after a track change. When LRCLIB has synced lyrics, it includes the line that matches that position.

- Playback detection for macOS, Linux, and Windows using the Spotify desktop session.
- Synced lyrics with a local cache and an offline mode.
- Short, on-demand audio clips with acoustic measurements on supported audio backends.

## Try it

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/Aphygo/antigravity-spotify#installation), start a track in Spotify, and ask Antigravity “What’s playing right now?”

The attached 20-second demo uses fictional tracks and actual plugin output to show the first update, a repeated track, and a track change with the current lyric.

## Verification

The plugin passed strict validation with Google Antigravity CLI 1.5.16 and all 11 unit tests. The macOS installer and Spotify playback lookup were checked on Apple Silicon.
